title: Xuxa Evokes Emotions in Curitiba with Her Last Spaceship Show
seoTitle: Xuxa's Last Spaceship Show Evokes Emotions in Curitiba
subtitle: The “Last Flight of the Spaceship” tour unites fans of all generations at Arena da Baixada
excerpt: Xuxa's show in Curitiba brings together international fans, an SBT activation, and former 'paquitas', showcasing the emotional power of the Queen of the Little Ones.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The “Last Flight of the Spaceship” tour arrived at Arena da Baixada this Saturday (26), bringing a mix of nostalgia, reunions, and tributes to the Paraná capital. The event, which marks the farewell of Brazilian television's most famous spaceship, has generated significant excitement among diverse audiences.

Fan Travels from New York to Attend the Show

Camila Send, a personal chef living in the United States, flew from New York to enjoy the performance in Curitiba. The fan has a tattoo of Xuxa's spaceship on her skin, a symbol of new beginnings and fulfilled dreams. She recounts that her meeting with the presenter in 2019, in New York, granted her three childhood wishes, including becoming a chef. Camila intends to deliver a thank-you letter to Xuxa during the show.

SBT Delivers VIP Tickets to Fans at the Arena Gates

During the program Sessão +SBT Show, the network carried out an activation at the arena entrance. Ten fans without tickets received envelopes; only one contained the winning ticket, which guaranteed two VIP entries to the show. In a recorded message, Xuxa thanked the affection and respect of the network that "embraces" her and highlighted SBT's coverage of the performance.

Former 'Paquitas' from Caxias do Sul Travel to Relive Childhood

Four women who performed as 'paquitas' in Caxias do Sul in the 1990s – Taísa Festugato, Liciane Festugato, Liziane Viapiana, and Liliam Silvestre – embarked this Saturday for Curitiba. They recall how, in 1991, the routine of watching Xuxa on television inspired them to create a group that choreographed her songs and performed at parties and schools. For them, the Queen of the Little Ones' show represents an opportunity to reconnect with the artist who marked their childhoods.

The Tour Travels Across Brazil and Remains Scheduled

In addition to Curitiba, the tour has already visited São Paulo, with two sold-out shows, and has scheduled dates in Belo Horizonte and Rio de Janeiro. In 2027, the performance will return to São Paulo to conclude the tour at Nubank Parque.

Emotional Memory and the Symbolism of the Spaceship

For fans, Xuxa's spaceship symbolizes a new beginning. Camila Send explains that the opening and closing of the spaceship door are “synonymous with a fresh start.” The 'paquitas' recall that the spaceship was the starting point for their games and choreographies. The farewell of the spaceship on stage, therefore, reinforces the emotional bond the presenter maintains with generations who grew up watching her show.

With information from G1, Notícias da TV, GZH.
